Script-bearing HTML in the doc is sanitized (no handler survives), and a missing file shows an error message
instead of a blank page.
source: @pytest.mark.req("PUB-05") def test_evaluation_page_sanitizes_and_reports_errors(browser, server): """Script-bearing HTML in the doc is sanitized (no handler survives), and a missing file shows an error message instead of a blank page.""" page = browser.new_page() page.route("**/evaluation/evaluation.md", lambda r: r.fulfill(status=200, body="# T\n\n")) page.goto(f"{server}evaluation/") page.wait_for_selector("#evaluation h1", timeout=20000) assert page.evaluate("window.__x") is None assert page.locator("#evaluation [onerror]").count() == 0 page.close() page = browser.new_page() page.route("**/evaluation/evaluation.md", lambda r: r.fulfill(status=404, body="no")) page.goto(f"{server}evaluation/") page.wait_for_selector("#load-error:not([hidden])", timeout=20000) assert "HTTP 404" in page.inner_text("#load-error") page.close()
